scientific_integrity.limitations: No results for larger PSD cones, complex Hermitian matrices, general exponents, weighted independent entries, or metric projection under independent-entry distance. Numerical checks are not a continuum proof.
scientific_integrity.prior_work_note: The spectral projection formula and differentiability theory are established ingredients; the exact sharp cross-norm constants are the claimed contribution. Earlier equivalent formulations cannot be ruled out exhaustively.
scientific_integrity.scope: real symmetric two-by-two matrices; Frobenius-nearest PSD projection; independent-entry ell_1, ell_2, and ell_infinity input-output norms

title: Sharp independent-entry Lipschitz constants for \(2\times2\) semidefinite projection
